note: Plan-only prompts on fresh `claude -p --model haiku --tools "" --disable-slash-commands` sessions in an empty folder; the prompt goes in as the argument; control without the skill, with-skill run gets SKILL.md prepended. Grade from the answer text. Baseline 2026-10-13 (haiku, one run, scenario plan-new-issue) plus failures recorded from a real session in which about eight issues were filed by hand. The with-skill run has not been done yet.

evals.prompt: File a GitHub issue in lorenzh/rabe for this idea: show the cost of each subagent in the pane. Plan only: give the exact commands you would run and the exact shape of the issue body. Do not run anything.
evals.expected_output: searches existing issues first; verifies code claims against origin/<default branch> with file:line from grep; body with Idea or Problem, Data, Behaviour, Acceptance checkboxes, Open questions, Related issues; Conventional Commits title; private body file named for the issue; creates through gh api repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues with -F body=@file; reads milestone descriptions and picks by rule or says none fits; labels from gh label list via a second call; comments on related issues; reports URL and what was set
assertions: gh issue list --search runs before any create
the plan verifies code claims with git grep on the default branch and does not assert unverified facts
the body has an Acceptance checkbox list
the body file name is specific to this issue
creation uses gh api repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues, not gh issue create
milestone descriptions are read before one is chosen, or the reply says none fits
labels come from the repo's label list
related issues receive a comment with the new number
evals.source: claude -p --model haiku, 2026-10-13, tools disabled, empty folder
baseline_failures: no duplicate search: the plan went straight to writing and creating
wrote the body to a shared fixed name (/tmp/rabe-issue/body.md)
used gh issue create and gh issue view, not the REST API
stated 'subagent cost is only visible in aggregate today' as fact without checking the code
no milestone step: milestones were not read or set
labels planned from a guess ('enhancement, only if it exists') with no second call
no comment on related issues, no Related issues section
title was a plain sentence, not Conventional Commits

evals.prompt: You file three issues in one session, each in a separate background job, in lorenzh/skills. Give the exact path each job writes its body to and the exact create command.
evals.expected_output: one private file per issue, named for the issue; no shared body.md; REST create with -F body=@<that file>
assertions: each create command reads its own file
evals.source: real session: a shared body.md was overwritten by a parallel job and would have closed two issues wrongly
baseline_failures: body written to a shared temp file and overwritten by a parallel job

evals.prompt: `gh issue create` on lorenzh/rabe fails with 'GraphQL: Resource not accessible ... projectCards'. What do you do next? Give the exact commands.
evals.expected_output: does not retry gh issue create, view or edit; creates through gh api repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues, sets labels with a second call, re-reads the issue through gh api
assertions: no retry of gh issue create
REST create with -f title and -F body=@file
evals.source: real session: gh issue create/view/edit failed on a repo with Projects (classic) data
baseline_failures: agent retried gh issue create instead of switching to REST

evals.prompt: Write the 'Data' section for an issue claiming that the pane reads prices from data/prices.csv in the rabe repo. You have the checkout. Give the commands you run and the section.
evals.expected_output: runs git grep on origin/<default branch>; every line cites path:line from the output; unverified claims move to Open questions
assertions: git grep or equivalent runs before the section is written
